purpose: Close allocation, visibility, baseline and ABBA execution ambiguities before development generator or mechanism source exists.

card_interpretation.development_count: The card value 16 means 16 independently seeded cases per named development family, hence 64 development cases total.
card_interpretation.locked_count: The card value 48 means 48 cases per future generator-family-disjoint locked family, not 48 cases total.
card_interpretation.locked_policy: Locked family names, implementations, seeds and serialized inputs do not exist during development. After a complete development pass, a result-blind author who has not opened development results must preregister exactly three eligible and one dense-control generator families, each implementation-disjoint from all development and JAC001/JAC002 generators, before any locked materialization. The author may read this amendment and generator contracts but not development summaries, traces or timings. A machine-readable no-result-access attestation is mandatory. A development failure creates no locked source or input.

prohibitions: No seed is selected by retry or outcome.
No JAC001 or JAC002 seed registry, serialized object, graph, matrix, start, family or outcome is read by the generator or materializer.
A collision against the repository-wide retired-seed denylist aborts materialization rather than shifting the seed.

opaque_identity_contract.construction: opaque_case_id is the first 24 lowercase hexadecimal characters of SHA-256 over the UTF-8 string 'jac3-v1/case/' followed by decimal family_ordinal, '/', and decimal case_index.
opaque_identity_contract.collision_policy: All 64 opaque IDs must be unique; any collision aborts materialization.
candidate_visibility: The execution harness may use opaque_case_id only to pair byte-identical candidate payloads and joins.
The candidate provider, route and local iteration kernel receive no case ID, family ID, factor descriptor, seed, Gold value, analytic Jacobian or baseline trace.
Candidate payloads contain typed graph, bounds, scales, starts and hard budgets only.
Assessor payloads alone contain family, factors, seeds, analytic roots/Jacobians, branch truth and dense-control traces.

factor_allocation.selection_rule: The generator contains one immutable 16-row descriptor table per family. Row order is case_index order; seeded topology or coefficient permutations make repeated factor rows independent. No cartesian grid truncation or retry is allowed.
factor_allocation.materialization_gate: The independent assessor recomputes counts from serialized descriptors and aborts unless every minimum is met exactly as declared by the generator source. The source lock freezes the descriptor tables before mechanism implementation.

gold_and_trace_separation.dense_jacobian_rule: Analytic dense-J truth is computed by separately coded symbolic formulas in the assessor module. K0 traces are produced only by the unchanged public dense solve_local control and are stored separately; neither is embedded in candidate inputs.
gold_and_trace_separation.gold_rule: Gold configurations, targets, branch labels and factor/family descriptors are assessor-only. Candidate-visible files must fail a forbidden-key recursive scan for family, factor, seed, gold, truth, expected, analytic, jacobian, target and branch_label.
gold_and_trace_separation.hash_rule: Each gzip member is deterministic and its uncompressed canonical JSON SHA-256 is recorded alongside the compressed-file SHA-256. Pairing verifies both hashes before execution.

public_baseline_contract.reason: This is the last product-source commit affecting the current solve_local/JAC001 seam before EXP-JAC002; the terminal EXP-JAC002 integration records that prepared_coloring product commits were never merged.
must_match: Exact exported solve_local method signatures and keyword names, including jacobian_entries but excluding prepared_coloring.
PROBLEM_WIRE_VERSION, PLUGIN_WIRE_VERSION, SOLVE_OPTIONS_WIRE_VERSION, SOLVE_RESULT_WIRE_VERSION and CHECKPOINT_WIRE_VERSION.
Source hashes for local_solver.jl, solver.jl, checkpoint_json.jl, protocol_json.jl and GeoTargetCore.jl.
A fixed checkpoint fixture's canonical bytes, resume identity and round-trip result once baseline capture is executed.
public_baseline_contract.failure_rule: Any mismatch aborts baseline capture or materialization. It is not repairable by updating expected hashes after mechanism source exists.

preconditions: The preregistration, amendment, generator and baseline source hashes match preimplementation-lock.json.
The baseline product-source snapshot matches the baseline commit and current worktree.
The experiment source tree equals the allowlisted preimplementation manifest and contains no candidate/provider/mechanism source or output directory.
No development output or one-shot completion marker exists.
one_shot_materialization.atomicity: Write all candidate, assessor, control-trace, baseline-snapshot and manifest artifacts to a sibling staging directory, validate cross-file joins and hashes, then atomically rename the directory and create the completion marker last.
one_shot_materialization.rerun_policy: A second invocation always fails, including after partial publication. Recovery requires deleting the entire uncommitted worktree and recreating it from the preimplementation source-lock commit; force and overwrite options do not exist.
one_shot_materialization.mechanism_detection: The materializer hashes an explicit preimplementation file allowlist and all GeoTargetCore product sources. Any added experiment Python/Julia source, any changed allowlisted source, any product-source drift, or any path containing candidate, provider, prepared_coloring, cached_coloring or mechanism aborts before generation.

formal_abba_protocol.unit: One outer exclusive-run audit owns all four segments for one partition. Each segment is one fresh Julia process that visits every case in the same opaque-ID order and all 32 starts in saved order.
formal_abba_protocol.compiled_runner_lifetime: Within a segment, each case is compiled exactly once, its 32 starts run consecutively, and all case-owned state is destroyed before the next case. K1 constructs exactly one provider after graph compilation for that case. No state crosses cases or processes.
formal_abba_protocol.cache_isolation: Each segment receives a fresh writable Julia depot overlay created from the same checksummed read-only preflight template. Segment-generated caches cannot be read by a later segment. JULIA_NUM_THREADS=1, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1, startup files are disabled, the package/manifest lock is identical and no process is reused.
formal_abba_protocol.timing_boundary: Fully charged segment wall begins before Julia process launch and ends after canonical trace flush and process exit. Common environment-template creation, source/hash validation and final aggregation occur outside the metric but are separately timed. Graph compilation, Julia specialization reached after launch, provider construction, routing, all 32 attempts, fallback and canonical replay are inside.
formal_abba_protocol.budgets: The 60-second value is an observation checkpoint and the 180-second value is a hard per-case per-segment deadline. A case timeout remains in the paired sample with 180 seconds charged, zero Gold success and all unfinished starts marked budget-exhausted.

aggregation.case_k0_wall: Arithmetic mean of ABBA slots 1 and 4 for the case.
aggregation.case_k1_wall: Arithmetic mean of ABBA slots 2 and 3 for the case.
aggregation.k1_repeat_gate: Each K1 slot is compared separately with the mean K0 wall for every case and after overall aggregation; neither overall K1 repetition may regress.
aggregation.family_uncertainty: Within each required family, use a deterministic 20000-replicate case-cluster bootstrap over the 16 opaque case pairs. For the overall claim, resample the three eligible family means as clusters. The bootstrap seed namespace is jac3-analysis-v1 and is frozen in the analysis source lock.
aggregation.missing_or_failed_segment: No partial ABBA sequence is analyzable. A crash, lease loss, staging mismatch, missing case or nonzero child exit invalidates the complete four-segment run; it cannot be resumed or concatenated.

formal_abba_protocol.contention_and_publication: The cross-worktree lease and host observer cover environment staging plus all four segments. Segment outputs remain in nonofficial staging and are atomically published together only after sequence, source, input, process-isolation and host-contention validation pass.
counterexamples_closed: Fresh PIDs sharing a writable depot would let an earlier segment warm a later segment.
Compiling one variant once and reusing that process would undercharge candidate construction.
Dropping timeouts or failed starts would favor the more fragile variant.
Restarting only a failed segment would destroy ABBA position balance.
Changing case/start order by variant would confound wall and recall pairing.
Publishing a completed K0 prefix before K1 finishes would expose an outcome and permit selective abort.

change_rule: This amendment is committed before generator source. Any correction requires a new committed amendment before generator source exists. Once generator source is committed, allocation, visibility, baseline, one-shot and ABBA rules are immutable; any violation terminates EXP-JAC-003 without locked materialization or product connection.
